assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE premium Deck virtual-card face asset to ship on a real product website. Reference image is the approved Deck identity board, ONLY for exact lowercase deck lettering proportions, three-layer Riff shape and palette. Do NOT reproduce the board. Completely redesign the existing puffy sculptural card aesthetic into precise industrial design: a very thin satin-anodized metal card face, nearly flat, quiet, sophisticated, believable close-up studio material. Straight-on orthographic front view, horizontal 1.586:1 payment-card proportions, gently rounded corners, card silhouette fills almost entire image with only 1% transparent margin. Native transparent background. No perspective, rotation, external shadow, white backing, white border, raised blobs, chunky sculpted ribbons or glass. Small accurate lowercase 'deck' wordmark at top left occupying about 19% card width. On the right half, three extremely fine, shallow engraved flowing channels derived from the three-layer Riff curve, extending toward and off the right edge, subtle grazing edge light, barely raised, restrained architectural precision. Keep left half and bottom 25% calm for HTML card information added later. Only text is 'deck'. No currency, PAN, names, chip, contactless symbol, network or issuer marks, watermarks, extra logos. The result should feel like a boutique industrial design studio's carefully manufactured luxury payment card, not a 3D toy, illustration or web interface. Warm ember orange #FF6B3D satin lacquer over aluminum; uniform rich orange midtone with subtle realistic anisotropic micro-brushing, deep blackberry #3D1C2E wordmark. The thin engraved channels are orange-on-orange, lighting is warm neutral.
